content: Response Generation: In this module, the semantic representation of the system's next action is transformed into natural language. Hence, each possible action is mapped to precisely one utterance, which is stored in the templates. Some of the predefined responses are fixed (i.e., “Welches Kapitel bearbeitest du gerade?”), others have placeholders for system values. In the latter case, the utterance can be formulated dependent on the actual ID. The dialogue showcases can be found in Section SECREF14 of the Appendix.
